This paper introduces the preparation of TC4-Nb-NiTi bionic layered heterogeneous structure alloy components using MWAAM with Nb as the interlayer.
The bionic layered heterogeneous multi-material alloy component with dimensions of 80 × 8 × 40 mm3 was fabricated on the TC4 substrate by MWAAM.
The TC4 layer was composed of α-Ti and β-Ti.
The TC4 layer was composed of α-Ti and β-Ti.
The TC4/Nb layer was mainly composed of α-Ti, β-Ti and (Nb, Ti) solid solution phases, and no other intermetallic compounds had been observed.
The phase ratio fraction of NiTi2 phase was 6.52% in Nb-NiTi interface region.
the microstructure of TC4 layer was mainly a basketweave structure formed by the interlacing arrangement of lamellar α.

a cellular network eutectic structure was formed on the NiTi side, as shown in Fig. 5f. The eutectic structure was mainly composed of (Nb, Ti) phase (Point 4) and NiTi(Nb) phase (Point 5) according to the EDS results

The content of brittle phase such as NiTi2 was greatly reduced on the NiTi side, indicating that Nb acted as a diffusion barrier to prevent diffusion, thus inhibiting the formation of brittle intermetallic compounds.
However, the TC4/Nb gradient layer was thin and the segregation region was small, which was not enough to greatly affect the properties of alloy components.

NiTi 2 phase with high hardness intensified the stress concentration phenomenon in eutectic region, which was easy to form dislocation plugging, provided favorable conditions for the formation of pores, and accelerated the propagation of cracks
The TC4 alloy side was mainly composed of α -Ti, β -Ti and (Nb, Ti) solid solution phases
when the crack propagated near the (Nb, Ti) and NiTi eutectic blocks, the crack bypassed the NiTi phase by deflecting
